heading: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
1. Purpose
AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
1. Purpose
data.text:
Section: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy > 1. Purpose

This policy defines mandatory requirements for identifying, classifying, restricting and governing customer data used in artificial intelligence, machine learning, analytics and experimentation activities.

heading: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
2. Scope
AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
2. Scope
data.text:
Section: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy > 2. Scope

This policy applies to customer datasets used for analytics or AI purposes, including raw extracts, curated datasets, feature tables, labelled data, test and validation data, event logs, customer feedback, model inputs and derived datasets.

heading: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
3. Policy Objective
AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
3. Policy Objective
data.text:
Section: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy > 3. Policy Objective

Customer data must be assessed before use. Restricted or high-risk customer information must be flagged. Data that violates an applicable rule must not be used for analytics or AI processing unless an approved exception is recorded.

heading: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
4. Definitions
AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
4. Definitions

table.Policy definition: Information relating to an identifiable or reasonably identifiable customer.
A data item that can identify a customer on its own.
A data item that may identify a customer when combined with other attributes.
Customer information requiring additional controls because of its sensitivity or potential impact.
Any dataset used to analyse, segment, predict or improve customer-related outcomes.
A record where one or more policy rules identify restricted or potentially identifying customer information.
Action taken to remove, mask, tokenise, generalise or otherwise reduce the data risk before use.

heading: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
6. Mandatory Policy Requirements
AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
6. Mandatory Policy Requirements

table.Policy statement: Customer datasets must be scanned for identifying and restricted data before analytics or AI use.
Each record containing direct, restricted or combination-based customer data must be flagged.
Direct identifiers must be removed, masked, tokenised or replaced before approval for general analytics use.
Restricted customer data must be blocked unless documented approval and control justification exists.
Records matching combination rules must be reviewed and remediated before use.
Comments, complaints, notes, descriptions and feedback must be scanned for identifying or restricted information.
Customer data must only be used for the approved analytics or AI purpose for which access was granted.
Only records with no unresolved policy findings may be included in the approved dataset.
Exceptions must be documented, risk-assessed, time-bound and approved by the designated data governance authority.
Scan results, triggered rules, decisions, remediation status and approvals must be retained for audit purposes.

heading: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
7. Dataset Decision Outcomes
AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
7. Dataset Decision Outcomes

table.Meaning: No restricted or suspected customer data has been detected.
table.Required action: Record may be included in the approved analytics dataset.

table.Meaning: Direct or combination-based customer-identifying data has been detected.
table.Required action: Record must be remediated before general analytics or AI use.

table.Meaning: Restricted data or a high-risk identifier has been detected.
table.Required action: Record must be excluded unless an approved exception exists.

table.Meaning: Documented approval permits controlled use of the record.
table.Required action: Use only under the approved conditions and retain audit evidence.

heading: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
8. Remediation Requirements
AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
8. Remediation Requirements

table.Policy expectation: Delete the customer data field or remove the record where the information is not required.
Replace part of the value while preserving limited analytical utility, where appropriate.
Replace a customer identifier with a non-identifying token.
Reduce precision, such as replacing exact location with region or age with an age band.
Combine records or values so individual customers cannot reasonably be inferred.
Transform data so customers are no longer reasonably identifiable.

heading: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
9. Minimum Evidence Required
AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
9. Minimum Evidence Required

table.Requirement: Name and version of the dataset assessed.
Date when the dataset was scanned.
List of policy rules triggered by each flagged or blocked record.
PASS, FLAG, BLOCK or EXCEPTION APPROVED.
Not required, pending, completed or exception approved.
Approved analytics or AI purpose for which the dataset is being used.
Named reviewer or approval reference where required.

heading: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
10. Non-compliance
AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy
10. Non-compliance
data.text:
Section: AI Customer Analytics Data Governance Policy > 10. Non-compliance

Datasets with unresolved customer-data findings must not be used for unapproved analytics, AI or experimentation. Non-compliance may result in suspension of dataset access, removal of system access, escalation to the data owner, remediation requirements or other action determined by the organisation.
